title: Bitumen Logistics & Packaging | PetroBind Global
text:
LOGISTICS & PACKAGING
MIDDLE EAST SUPPLY ROUTES CONNECTED TO GLOBAL BITUMEN BUYERS.

PetroBind coordinates bitumen import logistics from origin planning to destination readiness. The map highlights the Middle East as a supply point connected to Malaysia, Singapore, Australia, and wider international buyers, without tying the offer to one fixed port before the RFQ is qualified.

PACKAGING MODES

ONE OPERATIONAL PIPELINE, SEVERAL PRACTICAL FORMATS.
STEEL DRUMS

Containerized shipments for practical unloading, resale, and project-site storage.

JUMBO BAGS / CARTONS

Commonly evaluated for oxidized bitumen and solid handling requirements.

BITUTAINER / ISO TANK

Containerized heated logistics where route, discharge, and receiving setup allow.

BULK VESSEL

Volume-led supply for terminals, asphalt plants, and infrastructure programmes.

ROUTE CONTROL
WE QUALIFY THE ROUTE BEFORE ASKING BUYERS TO TRUST THE PRICE.

A low number on a quotation can become expensive when packaging, unloading, freight timing, or documents are not aligned. PetroBind keeps the trade path visible so buyers can judge the whole landed supply plan.

Procurement Support
RFQ REVIEW

Grade, quantity, destination port, Incoterm, packing preference, and delivery window are clarified first.

PACKING MATCH

We check whether drums, jumbo bags, bitutainers, tanks, or bulk cargo fit the product and buyer site.

FREIGHT PLANNING

The trade route is reviewed from loading origin through transshipment, customs, and destination handling.

DOCUMENT CONTROL

COA, PDS, SDS/MSDS, invoice, packing list, bill of lading, origin certificate, and inspection files are coordinated where applicable.

RECEIVING READINESS

Storage, heating, discharge and handling are considered before packing is selected.

DESTINATION SUPPORT

Destination requirements are discussed early so the shipment does not become a document problem later.

INCOTERMS

FOB, CFR, CIF, DAP and other terms are reviewed against product, route, and buyer responsibility.
